title: Labeling mode
subtitle: Label the pages of a folder in order to train the question detection model. "Save to bank" also adds the questions to the question bank (no test).
labeledError: Could not load the list of previously labeled pages.
emptyHint: All images in it and its subfolders (webp, jpg, jpeg, png) are added to the pool; pages come in folder and file name order.
noImages: No images found in the selected folder.
allDone: All labeled — no pages left to label in this folder.
skipHint: Go to the next page without training (N)
trainHint: Add the page to the training data with all its questions marked

bank.hint: Save the page's questions with their correct options to the question pool without a test (subject/topic classification is automatic), then send the page for training like Train and go to the next page.
bank.noMcq: There are no multiple-choice questions to save to the pool.
bank.saved: {{count}} questions saved to the pool; classification started in the background.
bank.alreadySaved: This page's questions were already saved to the pool ({{count}} questions). Saving again creates them a second time.
bank.failed: The questions could not be saved to the pool.
bank.forbidden: Only teachers and admins can save questions to the pool.
bank.savedAndTrained: {{count}} questions saved to the pool and sent for training; classification started in the background.

cropDuplicate.title: This crop is already in the bank
cropDuplicate.message: The same question image is in the bank in {{count}} record(s).
cropDuplicate.question: Question #{{id}}
cropDuplicate.hint: Saving anyway creates the question a second time.

answerKey.title: Answer key page
answerKey.message: This page is in the book's answer key range. Save it as questions anyway?

pageLoadFailedHint: This page could not be read and cannot be sent for training. Continue with "Skip / Next".
predictFailedHint: Automatic detection failed. Press "Detect again" or draw the question boxes by hand; an empty canvas is not sent for training.
pageIdMismatch: The sent image did not match the open page; the page was not counted as labeled. Detect the page again and retry.

inspector.title: Question inspector
inspector.answerCountMismatch: Must have {{count}} choices; a mismatched question cannot be sent for training.
inspector.emptyHint: No questions on this page. Draw a question box or re-detect; Train with no questions sends the page as an empty page.

hint.activity: Activities are not sent to training or saved to the bank from this screen; they go to the activity flow.
hint.info_box: Info boxes are not cropped: they are not sent to training or the bank.
hint.answer_key: Answer keys are not cropped: they are not sent to training or the bank.
hint.noise: Noise (optical form, QR code, page header …) is not cropped: it is not sent to training or the bank.

source.label: Source
source.manualHint: The version sent to training (only when saved)
source.askAgainConfirm: Claude will be asked again and billed; the saved result will be overwritten.
source.askAgainConfirmEdits: Claude will be asked again (billed) and your unsaved corrections will be lost.
source.manualIsTraining: This is the version used for training.
source.manualExists: This page has a saved manual labeling; choose Manual to see it.
source.unsavedEdits: You have unsaved corrections; they will be lost if the source changes.
source.aiFailed: Claude could not label this page.
source.promptSaved: Prompt v{{version}} saved; the next Claude calls use it.

prompt.title: Claude prompt settings
prompt.hint: Saving creates a new version; old versions are kept. The coordinate rules and the response format (JSON) are fixed and not edited here. When the prompt changes, pages are sent to Claude again with the new prompt (billed).
prompt.placeholders: {width} and {height}: pixel size of the image sent to Claude
prompt.expandQuestionToOptions: Question box covers all of its choices
prompt.loadFailed: Prompt settings could not be loaded.
prompt.placeholderMissing: Warning: {width} or {height} is missing — without the pixel size Claude's boxes may drift.

activity.loadFailed: Activity instructions could not be loaded.
activity.hint: Crops of activity blocks of this type are sent to Claude with this instruction. Saving creates a new version; only this type's cache is invalidated (drafts of other types come from the cache). The response schema is fixed.
activity.missing: The server returned no instruction for this type.

prompt.unsavedOthers: Other tabs have unsaved changes; they will be lost if you save and close:

book.label: Book
book.noPageNumber: No page number in the file name
book.pageFailed: Book info could not be loaded
book.tocHint: From the table of contents: the subject / topic default when saving to the bank
book.tocGradeMismatch: The grade differs from the table of contents; the book topic will not be applied
book.tocStale: The table of contents entry is invalid (deleted topic)

structure.promptSaved: {{type}} instruction v{{version}} saved; in the question canvas, drafts of this type are extracted with the new instruction.
structure.promptUnchanged: Instruction unchanged (v{{version}}); nothing to extract again.
